title: UAAP: Parents of Adili, Baterbonia attend Ateneo game

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The parents of Divine Adili and Rene Baterbonia were in attendance at Mall of Asia Arena when Ateneo made its debut in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Wednesday. Elias and Ifeoma, Divine’s parents, were behind the bench of the Blue Eagles, who dominated the Red Warriors, 101-74, to open their campaign. Before the game, a moment of silence was held for Adili and Baterbonia, who died in a drowning incident during Ateneo’s training camp in Dipaculao, Aurora last June.
